name: eufemia-analytics
description: Store and retrieve records in AWS (S3 + Athena) via an HTTP API
author: DNB Team

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/lambda/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.mjs '--external:@aws-sdk/*' && cd dist && zip -rq lambda.zip index.mjs index.mjs.map
scripts.deploy: yarn build && terraform -chdir=infra init && terraform -chdir=infra apply -auto-approve
scripts.deploy:plan: yarn build && terraform -chdir=infra init && terraform -chdir=infra plan
